entities.summary: The Great Mosque of Bejaia or Al-Mansuriyah Mosque was a major historical mosque in Béjaïa, Algeria. It was built during the Hammadid Emirate around the year 1100 CE, under the reign of Al-Mansur ibn al-Nasir. The mosque was destroyed by the Spanish after they took the city in 1510.
